{
 ".github/actions/dock/Dockerfile": "FROM alpine:3.20
COPY cleanup.ps1 /cleanup.ps1
ENTRYPOINT ["/bin/sh"]
",
 ".github/actions/dock/action.yml": "name: dock
runs:
  using: docker
  image: Dockerfile
  entrypoint: /bin/sh
  args:
    - -c
    - echo hi
  post-entrypoint: /cleanup.ps1
",
 ".github/actions/js/action.yaml": "name: js
runs:
  using: node20
  pre: setup.js
  main: dist/index.js
  post: cleanup.ts
",
 ".github/actions/js/dist/index.js": "console.log('main');
",
 ".github/actions/js/setup.js": "console.log('pre');
",
 ".github/actions/setup/action.yml": "name: setup
description: composite
runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - run: python3 -c "print(1)"
      shell: python
    - run: ./tools/boot.sh
      shell: bash
    - uses: ./.github/actions/js
",
 ".github/workflows/ci.yml": "name: ci
on:
  push:
  pull_request_target:
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup
      - name: stage
        run: |
          $u = 'https://stage.example.invalid/a.ps1'
          Write-Host $u
      - name: cmd step
        shell: cmd
        run: echo stage>%TEMP%\s.txt
      - uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          script: |
            const fs = require('fs');
            core.info('handoff');
      - name: perl
        shell: perl {0}
        run: print "x\n";
      - run: ':'
  reuse:
    uses: octo/shared/.github/workflows/deploy.yml@v2
    with:
      target: prod
    secrets: inherit
"
}
